limits: No implementation fix, release rebuild, full-suite rerun or new accepted artifact in this design turn.
Performance mechanisms are candidates, not measured speed/memory improvements.
Temporary external-method prototype does not certify migration of the real project classes or @Class packaging.
No >2GB allocation, full Gaussian checkpoint run or whole-project dynamic graph/SCC proof was performed.
Source API removals are planned; existing file compatibility is separately mapped.
Probes capture expected errors and contract behavior; execution counts are not passing repaired tests.

reviewCorrections: Explicit Config constructor import preserves owner validators and declared custom keys.
All numerical bindings freeze at constructor completion; partial-instance initialize versus resume is explicit.
Tensor conversion and synchronized value permutation owned by common.fem sampling adapter.
Stable DatasetIds bind axes and palette across missing samples.
Uncommitted built-in graphics cleaned; callbacks run only on dedicated owner axes and return verified owned handles.
Endpoint preservation requires feasible vertex budget.
Legacy checkpoint identity is projected before comparison; explicit State.save filenames remain caller-owned.
Old source-interface removals are separated from wire-format compatibility and capability preservation.
